group.name: Operação Serenata de Amor
group.description: Operação Serenata de Amor is a technology project that uses artificial intelligence to audit public accounts and support social control. The idea came from the data scientist Irio Musskopf, as a way to actively participate in the democratic process, overseeing public spending. When sharing the idea with friends, it didn't take long for the project be spread all over the country, with a team of 10 people and more than 600 volunteers willing to do it.
